title: Backend production hardening
description: Bring the backend and deployment baseline to a clean, verifiable state. Work is decomposed into independently completable tasks below.

title: Audit API contract and handler behavior
description: Audit the existing /api/v1 handlers, middleware, error mapping, authentication boundaries, and tests. Fix concrete discrepancies found in code or tests; do not redesign the API without an explicit decision.

title: Harden PostgreSQL migrations and runtime roles
description: Verify Goose migrations, production allowlist, migrator ownership, runtime DML privileges, and migration failure behavior. Fix only reproducible correctness or security issues.

title: Verify concurrency and lifecycle invariants
description: Exercise team lifecycle, Hard Lock, submission, evaluation, row-lock ordering, and database-time rechecks. Add or strengthen regression tests for any proven race or lifecycle gap.

title: Harden deployment and gateway configuration
description: Validate Docker images, Compose topology, Nginx API gateway, health checks, secret boundaries, and local staging configuration. Keep the deployment API-only until product scope is explicitly defined.

title: Production observability and operational rehearsal
description: Verify structured logging, request IDs, health semantics, backup freshness checks, database cutover rehearsals, and failure-mode behavior. Convert concrete findings into follow-up Beads tasks.

title: Release gate and clean handoff
description: Run the final backend validation gates, verify repository cleanliness and absence of stale product-scope artifacts, and leave Beads in a state where the next agent can start from bd ready without reconstructing context.
